user.title: Pick your PS5
user.description: These consoles answered on your network. Pick yours, or type its IP address.

manual.title: PS5 IP address
manual.description: Type the console's IP address (Settings > Network > View Connection Status on the PS5). Give it a fixed IP in your router so it doesn't change. The PS5 must be on, or in rest mode with "Stay Connected to the Internet" turned on.

psn.title: Sign in to PlayStation Network
psn.description:
The PS5 doesn't tell your network what's playing, so PS5 Status asks PlayStation Network itself. No PlayStation Network integration needed.

1. Sign in at [playstation.com]({psn_url}) in a browser.
2. In the same browser open [this Sony page]({npsso_url}). It shows a short line with npsso and a long code.
3. Paste the 64-character code (or the whole line) below.

Add more accounts later (roommates, guests) under Configure, so it shows who's playing on {name}. Leave it empty for power only.

error.no_answer: No PS5 answered at that address. Check the IP, and that the console is on or in rest mode with Stay Connected to the Internet turned on.
error.bad_npsso: Sony refused that NPSSO token. Get a fresh one (step 2) while signed in and paste it again.
error.psn_down: PlayStation Network didn't answer. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: That PS5 is already set up.
abort.no_answer: The PS5 stopped answering. Make sure it's on and try again.

data.psn_entity: Game source media player (only without PSN accounts)
data.off_after: Missed answers before it counts as off

data_description.psn_entity: The old way: take the game from another media player. Ignored once a PSN account is added.
data_description.off_after: One dropped network packet shouldn't flip it off. 3 checks at 5 seconds means about 15 seconds.
data_description.psn_interval: Only while the PS5 is on. PSN limits how often it can be asked, so 30 seconds or more.

link.title: Link for turning on
link.description:
To turn the PS5 on, Home Assistant links with it like the PS Remote Play app does (once).

1. On the PS5: **Settings > System > Remote Play > Link Device**. It shows an 8-digit code.
2. Pick your PSN account (filled in from the PSN accounts you added) or type your PSN account ID number.
3. Type the code and submit while it's still on screen.

The PS5 must be on and Remote Play turned on (Settings > System > Remote Play > Enable Remote Play).

add_account.title: Add a PSN account
add_account.description:
Whoever of these accounts is signed in on the PS5 shows as who's playing.

Sign in as that person at [playstation.com]({psn_url}), then open [this Sony page]({npsso_url}) and paste the code. Tokens last about 2 months; when one stops working, add it again with the same name to replace it.

data.remove: Remove (removing your account also removes friends added through it)

add_friend.title: Add a friend
add_friend.description: Which of your accounts is friends with them on PSN?

pick_friend.title: Add a friend
pick_friend.description:
Pick a friend from {via}'s PSN friends list. When they're on a PS5 while yours is on, they show as who's playing.

Their PSN privacy settings have to let friends see their online status and what they're playing.

data.name: Name to show (blank for their PSN name)

error.bad_account: The PSN account ID is a long number. Pick your account from the list (add it under Add a PSN account first).
error.name_taken: That name is already used. Pick another one.

abort.npsso_expired: That account's NPSSO token expired. Add the account again with a fresh token first.
abort.psn_down: PlayStation Network didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
abort.no_friends: That account has no PSN friends to pick from.
